# Pandat 2025 CALPHAD software suite

[*Computherm, LLC, Madison, WI, USA*](https://www.computherm.com/)

::: {.callout-note}
CALPHAD is used to predict phase diagrams and thermodynamic properties of multicomponent systems, enabling the design and optimization of new and existing materials.
:::

![](/files/photos/Capabilities/Images_1.png){image-alt="Pandat CALPHAD simulation of a phase diagram"}

## Thermodynamic and Mobility Databases

| Database | Version | Scope                                                                                            |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| PanAl    | 2024    | Aluminum alloys                                                                                  |
| PanNi    | 2024    | Nickel alloys, including superalloys                                                             |
| PanHEA   | 2025    | FCC high- and medium- entropy alloys, e.g. for corrosive environments and cryogenic applications |
| PanRHEA  | 2024    | BCC high- and medium- entropy alloys, e.g. refractory complex concentrated alloys                |
| PanNoble | 2024    | Copper alloys, Pb- and Sn-rich solders, and Ag-, Au-, Cu-, Ir-, Pd- and Pt-based noble alloys    |
| PanTi    | 2024    | Titanium alloys                                                                                  |
| PanIron  | 2024    | Steels                                                                                           |

## Modules

* PanPython SDK: Software development kit enabling custom Python interfacing with CALPHAD databases and calculations
* PanPhaseDiagram: Phase diagram calculation and visualization
* PanSolidification: Solidification path calculation and visualization
* PanPhaseField: Phase field simulation of microstructure evolution
* PanOptimizer: Optimization of CALPHAD model parameters
* PanEvolution: Simulation of phase transformations and microstructure evolution
